name: My Voice
tagline: Webcam eye tracking lets people who cannot speak or move build sentences and speak them in their own voice.
problem: Many stroke survivors lose speech and motor control but keep functional eye movement, the team says.
solution: A 3D gaze-tracking pipeline built with MediaPipe and OpenCV drives dwell selection in an anticipatory interface; Gemma suggests phrases, ElevenLabs recreates the user's voice, and translation covers English, Mandarin and Spanish.
demo_moment: Team-described: compose a request by gaze and hear it spoken.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH: Best Use of Gemma” among 307 submissions.
Uses an ordinary webcam instead of specialised hardware.

lessons: Use the one ability the user reliably keeps as the whole interface.
